A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–J support reliable comparison despite pagination changes.

before.justification: v3 reports original model experiments on four algorithmic creativity tasks and summarization, including extensive appendix analyses.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments and reports revised plotted results in Figures 4 and 6.

M1.justification: Teacherless training, diffusion, seed-conditioning, and inference procedures remain unchanged. Rewritten explanations in Sections 2–3 do not introduce a different method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Sibling Discovery, Triangle Discovery, Circle Construction, Line Construction, XSUM, and CNN/DailyMail. Added discussion of proteins and genomes supplies motivation, not new evaluations.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain next-token training, teacherless training, and absorbing/uniform diffusion variants. Seed, null, and pause-prefix comparisons already appear in v3; no evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Reported model configurations, training budgets, sampling settings, metrics, and checkpoint-selection procedures are unchanged. The revised plots do not establish a change in evaluation design.

E4.justification: Figure 6 updates the quantitative evidence comparing seed and null prefixes across decoding temperatures, revising an existing sensitivity analysis. No new conditions are introduced. The pause-prefix control explained further in Appendix E.1 already existed in Figures 18–20.

E5.justification: Figures 4 and 6 acquire error bars absent from v3. Their statistical meaning and associated run counts are not specified, so additional runs cannot be inferred. The existing disclosure of four-run averaging for Gemma remains unchanged.

E6.justification: Figures 4 and 6 revise several point estimates under the same documented settings. For example, Figure 4's absorbing-diffusion Triangle Discovery creativity changes from approximately 0.115 to 0.098, and Figure 6's greedy seed-conditioned Circle Construction score changes from 0.350 to approximately 0.333. The principal trends remain.

T1.justification: Task definitions, Equations (1)–(4), and the O(mn) versus O(mn²) reasoning are retained. Section 2.6 adds conceptual explanation and conjectural qualifications without a new formal assumption, derivation, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract and contribution list retain the same central claims: a controlled creativity testbed, benefits of multi-token approaches, and seed-conditioning comparable to temperature sampling. Added future-work suggestions do not redefine the contributions.

C2.justification: Section 2.6 more explicitly qualifies the proposed failure mechanism as conjectural and connects it to simplicity bias and gradient starvation. Appendix E.1 newly interprets the existing pause-prefix control as evidence against extra computation alone explaining seed-conditioning gains. Section 6's limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation and hyperparameter disclosures in Appendices C, D, and I, including Tables 1–3, are unchanged. The partial-code availability statement is also retained.

R1.justification: v4 adds references supporting biological sequence-modeling relevance, simplicity bias, gradient starvation, prompt variation, and compositional diffusion. These extend the existing positioning without replacing it; the earlier input-noise discussion is relocated to Appendix J.

P1.justification: Selected introductory, methodological, and discussion paragraphs are rewritten. Section 2.5 is renamed and expanded, and pause-prefix discussion moves to Appendix E.1. The overall section organization and most appendix prose remain intact.

P2.justification: Figures 4 and 6 are redrawn with error bars, with some axis scaling changes in Figure 4. Figure 6 moves between columns and receives a revised caption; Figure 7's caption is shortened. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v4 modestly improves the paper through more explicit qualification of its heuristic mechanism, better explanation of the existing pause-prefix control, and visible uncertainty in Figures 4 and 6. The gains are limited because the new error bars remain statistically undefined and the experimental scope is unchanged. Revised values preserve the main findings.
